title: Finite 4-Class Skin Type Head Experiment on Frozen ViT Features

truthfulDisclosures.previousHoldoutDiscrepancy: In previous 100-sample holdout test, 30.30% accuracy was computed exclusively over the 66 validly responded samples (20 correct / 66 answered). Total accuracy across all 100 samples was 20/100 (20.00%) with 34 rejections (25 glare/exposure, 7 landmarks, 2 low support).
truthfulDisclosures.datasetIndependenceLimitation: Splitting by image prefix eliminates identical image crops and augmentations (.rf., -Copy), but does not prove independent subject identities due to Kaggle dataset structure. All 200 previous samples are development evidence. The 99 test samples evaluated here were strictly held out from training and hyperparameter selection.
truthfulDisclosures.karmaConfidenceUncalibrated: The heuristic Karma score [0.40, 0.88] is a hand-weighted support index, NOT a calibrated probability. It is now returned as confidence=None in production, with heuristicSupport recorded in divergence info. Similarly, the 4-class head softmax output is an uncalibrated score.
truthfulDisclosures.combinationClassificationFinding: The learned 4-class head trained on Kaggle combination labels achieves Macro-F1 of 0.2459 and combination F1 of 0.2857, confirming that web/Kaggle combination labels exhibit extreme label noise and annotator inconsistency, where regional photometric divergence provides explainable physical grounding.
